symptoms_en: The whole network of veins turns yellow; young leaves become small and the plant is stunted; fruit is yellow-white and smaller and harder. Spread by whitefly.
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों की सारी शिराएँ पीली हो जाती हैं; नई पत्तियाँ छोटी रह जाती हैं और पौधा बौना रहता है; फल पीले-सफ़ेद, छोटे और कड़े होते हैं। यह सफ़ेद मक्खी से फैलता है।

symptoms_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: diseases of bhendi
symptoms_en.quote: Yellowing of the entire network of veins in the leaf blade is the characteristic symptom.

management_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: diseases of bhendi
management_en.quote: By selecting varieties resistant to yellow vein mosaic like Parbhani Kranti, Arka Abhay, Arka Anamika, and Varsha Uphar, the incidence of the disease can be minimised.

management_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: diseases of bhendi
management_en.quote: For sowing during the summer season, when the whitefly activity is high, the susceptible varieties should be avoided.

recipe_slugs.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
recipe_slugs.quote: For sucking pests (like thrips and whitefly) in the early stage: Spray Neemastra @ 200 litres per acre
recipe_slugs.note: Natural-farming guide (NITI); the recipe is matched to the pest class, not tested on this crop in Malwa.

recipe_slugs.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
recipe_slugs.quote: Fungus/Virus control: Spray 3–4 days old buttermilk mixed with 100 litres of water
recipe_slugs.note: Natural-farming guide (NITI); the recipe is matched to the pest class, not tested on this crop in Malwa.

management_en: Grow resistant varieties (Parbhani Kranti, Arka Abhay, Arka Anamika, Varsha Uphar) and avoid susceptible ones in summer, when whitefly is most active.
management_hi: प्रतिरोधी किस्में (परभणी क्रांति, अर्का अभय, अर्का अनामिका, वर्षा उपहार) लगाएँ और गर्मी में, जब सफ़ेद मक्खी सबसे सक्रिय होती है, संवेदनशील किस्में न लगाएँ।
